families: SELECT id, name, hue FROM families ORDER BY id
animals: SELECT a.*, (SELECT max(c.born_ms) FROM animals c WHERE c.parent_a_id = a.id OR c.parent_b_id = a.id) AS last_bred_ms FROM animals a WHERE a.died_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.id
log: SELECT strftime('%H:%M', at) AS t, text FROM (SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 120) ORDER BY id
